name: fn19_hbsattn_varlen_even_block_flag
reference: zhengqigao/hbsattn, hbsattn/fwd_triton_fix_tile_size.py (kernel body copied verbatim). Chosen deliberately as an obscure project (4 stars, Nov 2025) so that recognition of a famous implementation cannot substitute for verification -- see 'Familiarity Is a Confound' in the design document.
mechanism: The Triton kernel body is unmodified and correct: it masks the partial final K block whenever the EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK flag says the sequences are not block-aligned. One line of the launch wrapper computes that flag from the TOTAL packed length instead of from each sequence length. For a uniform batch the two agree. For a packed batch whose lengths are 100 and 156 the total (256) is a multiple of the 64-wide block while neither sequence is, so the flag is wrongly true and the kernel attends to keys belonging to the next sequence. Whether the flag is correct is a property of the cu_k_seqlens INPUT, not of anything visible in the kernel.

expected.ground_truth: EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK is derived from the total packed length rather than from each sequence length
